caller-address.description: Reported caller IP field, which can be an address, redaction or provider label.

caller-network.description: Network field reported in the audit request metadata.

delegation-principal.description: Selected principal identifiers from one reported service account delegation entry.

event-time.description: Google Cloud event time normalized to UTC at microsecond precision.

event-time-raw.description: Original Cloud Logging timestamp with the reported precision and offset.

insert-id.description: Cloud Logging insertId for this entry, where supplied.

location.description: Location reported in the monitored resource labels.

log-category.description: Cloud Audit Logs category from the native log name.

log-name.description: Native Cloud Logging logName as supplied by the producer.

monitored-project-id.description: Project ID reported in the monitored resource labels.

monitored-resource-type.description: Type of the Cloud Logging monitored resource.

operation-id.description: Identifier used by Cloud Logging to group entries belonging to an operation.

operation-producer.description: Producer of the reported operation identifier.

principal-email.description: Principal email field as reported, which may contain a redacted value.

principal-subject.description: Authenticated principal subject as reported by Google Cloud.

received-time.description: Cloud Logging reception time normalized to UTC.

resource-name.description: Resource name on which the operation was performed.

scope-id.description: Identifier of the environment named in logName.

scope-type.description: Scope kind from logName, such as projects or organizations.

service-name.description: Google Cloud API service name from protoPayload.serviceName.

severity.description: Cloud Logging severity label reported for the entry.

source-ip.description: Validated IP address derived from the reported caller address.

status-code.description: Explicit google.rpc.Status code reported for the overall operation.

user-agent.description: Caller-supplied user agent reported in the audit request metadata.

zone.description: Zone reported in the monitored resource labels.

description: A Google Cloud Audit Logs LogEntry describing a reported operation, its identity and source context.
name: google-cloud-audit-event
